title: Lockfile
description:
The `.zpkg.lock` file written next to `.zpkg.toml` after resolution.

Serialized as TOML with one `[[package]]` table per locked package,
Cargo.lock-style. Every entry pins the exact artifact hash and the VCS
tag it was published from, so installs are reproducible and every
artifact is traceable back to source.

nix-adapter.description:
Optional immutable provenance for completed Nix interoperability
translations. This additive field keeps lockfile version 1 readable by
current consumers while allowing newer writers to preserve evidence.

ArtifactFormat.description: On-the-wire formats for published package artifacts.

format.description:
Explicit archive format. A missing value must never be inferred during
a frozen install because the format is part of immutable artifact identity.

sha256.description: Canonical lowercase hex sha256 of the artifact archive; also its store address.

size.description: Artifact size in bytes. Zero-byte package artifacts are invalid.

source.description: Base URL of the registry the artifact was resolved from.

vcs_commit.description:
Exact immutable source revision associated with the published artifact.
The optional Rust representation preserves API compatibility for
builders, but lockfile parsing, schema generation, and serialization
all require this value to be explicitly present.

vcs_tag.description: VCS tag the version was published from, e.g. `v1.2.0`.

NixAdapterRecord.description:
Final, immutable provenance record for one completed translation.

`direction` is internally tagged in JSON so consumers cannot deserialize a
direction whose required origin/result fields are absent.

flake_bundle_sha256.description:
Hash of a canonical inventory of the generated standalone flake
bundle, not a filesystem-dependent archive of the output directory.

oneOf.description:
Export the exact immutable Zed artifact. Source-builder translation is
intentionally not inferred from native manifests in contract v1.

NixExportSection.description:
Author intent for exporting a package or target to Nix.

This structure contains no realized store paths, hashes, commands,
credentials, cache keys, or service deployment policy. Those belong in a
versioned adapter record after planning/realization.

attribute.description: Optional Nix package attribute. Omit it to use the Zed package name.

outputs.description:
Explicit derivation outputs. Contract v1 never silently selects the
first output of a multi-output derivation.

systems.description: Explicit Nix systems this package claims to support.

NixInteropArtifact.description:
Immutable Zed artifact identity used by both a Zed-origin source and the
translated artifact produced by Nix → Zed sealing.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the exact archive bytes.

NixOutputOrigin.description:
Immutable Nix source selector plus the exact realized output selected for a
Nix → Zed translation.

NixPackageIdentity.description:
Public Zed identity chosen for either translation direction. A Nix
attribute is a selector and never silently claims a Zed organization.

NixPolicyEvidence.description:
Evidence that the translation was planned/realized under a named policy.
This records policy state; it does not grant credentials or execute Nix.

NixRealizedOutput.description: Realization evidence for exactly one Nix system/output pair.

store_path.description: Diagnostic path only; `nar_hash` is the portable output identity.

NixStoreReference.description:
One referenced Nix store object. Portable Nix → Zed imports reject any
runtime references in contract v1; Zed → Nix output attestations may still
retain them as evidence.

ZedArtifactOrigin.description: Immutable source evidence when Zed is the dependency-resolution authority.

lock_sha256.description:
Hash of the exact `.zpkg.lock` bytes, omitted only for a dependency-free
package whose export plan proves no lock is required.

registry.description: Registry base URL used to resolve the exact artifact.
